{{Current events|year=2022|month=02|day=4|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]]n [[President of Austria|President]] [[Alexander Van der Bellen]] signs a law that makes the country the first in the [[European Union]] to mandate that people over the age of 18 years receive the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] after the [[Federal Council (Austria)|Bundesrat]] voted 47–12 yesterday to approve the law. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/feb/04/austria-passes-covid-vaccine-mandate-but-question-marks-linger-over-enforcement (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the 15th consecutive day of 168,201 new [[COVID-19]] cases, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 12.45 million. [https://interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/73790/ (Interfax)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 111,157 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkey-reports-111-157-new-coronavirus-cases-248-more-deaths-171290 (Hurriyet Daily News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States]] surpasses 900,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/4/us-covid-death-toll-sped-by-omicron-surpasses-900000 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Whaling in Iceland]]
**[[Iceland]] announces it will end the practice of [[whaling]] by 2024, citing the decreasing price of [[whale meat]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/4/iceland-to-end-whaling-as-demand-dwindles (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Montenegro]], [[2022 Montenegrin crisis]]
**The [[Krivokapić Cabinet|Government]] of [[Zdravko Krivokapić]] is ousted after a [[motion of no confidence]] passes 43–11. [https://www.dw.com/en/montenegros-government-toppled-in-no-confidence-vote/a-60668961 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Winter Olympics]]
**The [[2022 Winter Olympics]] [[2022 Winter Olympics opening ceremony|begin]] in [[Beijing]]. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/beijing-winter-olympics-2022-opening-ceremony-spt-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**Dutch journalist Sjoerd den Daas is [[2022 Winter Olympics dragging incident|interrupted and dragged away]] by a Chinese security guard as he broadcasts live from the ongoing Olympics. [https://www.newsweek.com/sjoerd-den-daas-winter-olympics-beijing-nos-1676546 (Newsweek)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**An American [[travel visa|visa]] is denied for an Iranian national wrestling team that had a coach who advocated [[Death to America]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/iran-regimes-death-america-wrestling-head-cancels-match-us-team-visa-denial (Fox News)]
